planets.name: TOI-2180 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-2180 with a 260-day year, found in 2022.

text.card: TOI-2180 b was found in 2022 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-2180. Its orbit and size follow Dalba et al. 2022's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname DALBA_ET_AL__2022): disc_year 2022, disc_facility Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite (TESS), sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 260.15764, pl_radj 1.01, pl_bmassj 2.755

quotes.title: TOI-2180 b
quotes.card: TOI-2180 b is a giant exoplanet orbiting the G-type star TOI-2180, also known as HD 238894.
quotes.introduction: It was discovered with the help of the Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite and is currently the exoplanet with the longest orbital period TESS was able to uncover.
